title: docs: align AI guides + ADR-0040 with the ask/build two-agent model (ADR-0063/0064)
body:
Follow-up to #2194. After the code split (#2181/cloud#417) and the skill-authoring-contract sweep (#2194), the **docs site** and **ADR-0040** still described the superseded unified-assistant / tenant-custom-agent model. This sweeps the four spots flagged in the assessment.

## What changed
- **`content/docs/guides/ai-capabilities.mdx`** — reframed the "AI Agents" section:
  - Leads with the two surface-bound platform agents (`ask` OSS/free, `build` cloud/paid); no per-turn classifier, no roster.
  - New "You extend the platform with **skills**, not agents" subsection — ADR-0063 §2 (`*.agent.ts` closed to third parties, `allowRuntimeCreate:false`) + ADR-0064 (tools = union of surface-compatible skills' tools; `surface:'build'` inert on OSS).
  - Added the `surface` field to the AgentSchema table; recontextualized the `defineAgent()` examples with a warning callout that they show **anatomy**, not a tenant-authoring tutorial.
- **`content/docs/guides/plugin-chatbot-integration.mdx`** — code/curl examples use `ask`, not the legacy `data_chat` alias.
- **`docs/adr/0040-unified-assistant-and-agent-binding.md`** — added a Superseded-by-ADR-0063 banner + Status line; body kept as the historical record (ADRs are immutable).

## Verification
- Generated schema refs (`references/ai/agent.mdx:79`, `skill.mdx:39`) already carry the `surface` field — `build-docs.ts` reruns with **no diff**, so no regeneration was needed.
- Left as historical (intentionally **not** touched): ADR-0015, the `2026-06-ask-build` audit, CHANGELOGs, `docs/plans/*`, test fixtures.

Docs-only (`skip-changeset`).

Refs #2168
